messages.subject: Error replacing sampler in parallel
parts:

It works fine when running one model at a time, but fails when replacing one of the samplers in a parallel environment, even in the case of running a single instance in a parallel environment (1 core). It gives the error "Error in unserialize(socklist[[n]]: error reading from connection". The line in red below is the culprit. I've copied the offending "GSampler" code below. I know the file with the custom updates is loading because the error does not occur when replacing the "IDsampler" directly above where "GSampler" is replaced and both are in the same .R file which is loaded inside the foreach loop.

Ideas?

Ben

#------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom sampler to update G.true, subject to constraints stemming from G.use
#------------------------------------------------------------------
GSampler <- nimbleFunction(
  contains = sampler_BASE,
  setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
    # Defined stuff
    M <- control$M
    J <- control$J
    K2D <- control$K2D
    nlevels <- control$nlevels
    calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)
  },
  run = function() {
    #Structures for the SCR observation model likelihood
    lam <- model$lam
    lam.cand <- matrix(0,nrow=M,ncol=J)
    G.true <- model$G.true
    ll.y.sight <- rep(0,J)
    ll.y.sight.cand <- rep(0,J)
   
    #Update first ID covariate, G.true[,1]. Metropolis-Hastings
    swap <- which(model$G.latent[1:M]==1) #can only update currently latent G's
    for(i in 1:length(swap)){
      G.cand <- rcat(1,model$gammaVec[1:nlevels])
      if(G.cand!=model$G.true[swap[i]]){
        #update ll.y
        d2 <- (model$s[swap[i],1]-model$X[1:J,1])^2 + (model$s[swap[i],2]-model$X[1:J,2])^2 #ideally wouldn't need to recalculate this
        lam.cand[swap[i],1:J]<- model$lam0[G.cand]*exp(-d2/(2*model$sigma[G.cand]^2))
        if(model$z[swap[i]]==1){
          ll.y.sight <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
          ll.y.sight.cand <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam.cand[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
        }else{
          ll.y.sight <-rep(0,J)
          ll.y.sight.cand <-rep(0,J)
        }
        #update ll.cat
        ll.cat <- dcat(G.true[swap[i]],prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        ll.cat.cand <- dcat(G.cand,prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        prop.for <- model$gammaVec[G.cand]
        prop.back <- model$gammaVec[G.true[swap[i]]]
       
        #sum log likelihoods and do MH step
        lp_initial <- ll.cat+sum(ll.y.sight)
        lp_proposed <- ll.cat.cand+sum(ll.y.sight.cand)
        log_MH_ratio <- (lp_proposed+log(prop.back)) - (lp_initial+log(prop.for))
        accept <- decide(log_MH_ratio)
       
        if(accept){
          G.true[swap[i]] <- G.cand
          lam[swap[i],] <- lam.cand[swap[i],]
        }
       
      }
    }
    #Put stuff back into model
    model$lam <<- lam
    model$G.true <<- G.true
   
    #update logProb
    model.lp.proposed <- model$calculate(calcNodes)
   
    copy(from = model, to = mvSaved, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
  },
  methods = list( reset = function () {} )
)



#####Nimble Model

NimModel <- nimbleCode({
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  # priors for detection and augmentation parameters
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  for(i in 1:nlevels){
      lam0[i]~dunif(0,10)       
      sigma[i]~dunif(0,10)
  }
  psi~dunif(0,1)
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  # dirichlet priors for category/genotype level frequencies
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  for(k in 1:nlevels){
    alpha[k] <- 1 # parameters
  }
  gammaVec[1:nlevels]~ddirch(alpha[1:nlevels])
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  # likelihoods
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  for(i in 1:M) {
    # latent activity centers
    # currently this assumes a rectangular state space
    # could apply some form of the Meredith trick for an irregular state space
    s[i,1] ~ dunif(xlim[1],xlim[2])
    s[i,2] ~ dunif(ylim[1],ylim[2])
    lam[i,1:J] <- GetDetectionRate(s = s[i,1:2], X = X[1:J,1:2], J=J,
                                   sigma=sigma[G.true[i]], lam0=lam0[G.true[i]], z=z[i],ID=ID[1:n.samp.latent],
                                   G.latent=G.latent[1:M])#ID and G.latent here as a NIMBLE hack
    # Capture model
    # but y.sight.true is latent, requires custom update - see custom IDsampler
    for(j in 1:J) {
      y.sight.true[i,j] ~ dpois(K2D[i,j]*lam[i,j])
    }
   
    # Model for categorical identity covariates/genotypes (individual by covariate)
    # G.true also requires custom update - see GSampler 
   
    G.true[i]~dcat(gammaVec[1:nlevels])
   
  }
 
  # Data augmentation part
  for(i in (n.marked+1):M){
    z[i] ~ dbern(psi)
  }
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  #calculate number of unmarked inds captured, and total pop size
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  n.cap <- Getncap(y.sight.true=y.sight.true[1:M,1:J],z=z[1:M],M=M,J=J,n.marked=n.marked)
  N <- sum(z[1:M])
})# end model

  contains = sampler_BASE,
  setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
    # Defined stuff
    M <- control$M
    J <- control$J
    K2D <- control$K2D
    nlevels <- control$nlevels
    calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)
  },
  run = function() {
    #Structures for the SCR observation model likelihood
    lam <- model$lam
    lam.cand <- matrix(0,nrow=M,ncol=J)
    G.true <- model$G.true
    ll.y.sight <- rep(0,J)
    ll.y.sight.cand <- rep(0,J)
   
    #Update first ID covariate, G.true[,1]. Metropolis-Hastings
    swap <- which(model$G.latent[1:M]==1) #can only update currently latent G's
    for(i in 1:length(swap)){
      G.cand <- rcat(1,model$gammaVec[1:nlevels])
      if(G.cand!=model$G.true[swap[i]]){
        #update ll.y
        d2 <- (model$s[swap[i],1]-model$X[1:J,1])^2 + (model$s[swap[i],2]-model$X[1:J,2])^2 #ideally wouldn't need to recalculate this
        lam.cand[swap[i],1:J]<- model$lam0[G.cand]*exp(-d2/(2*model$sigma[G.cand]^2))
        if(model$z[swap[i]]==1){
          ll.y.sight <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
          ll.y.sight.cand <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam.cand[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
        }else{
          ll.y.sight <-rep(0,J)
          ll.y.sight.cand <-rep(0,J)
        }
        #update ll.cat
        ll.cat <- dcat(G.true[swap[i]],prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        ll.cat.cand <- dcat(G.cand,prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        prop.for <- model$gammaVec[G.cand]
        prop.back <- model$gammaVec[G.true[swap[i]]]
       
        #sum log likelihoods and do MH step
        lp_initial <- ll.cat+sum(ll.y.sight)

#------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom sampler to update G.true, subject to constraints stemming from G.use
#------------------------------------------------------------------
GSampler <- nimbleFunction(
  contains = sampler_BASE,
  setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
    # Defined stuff
    M <- control$M
    J <- control$J
    K2D <- control$K2D
    nlevels <- control$nlevels
    calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)
  },
  run = function() {
    #Structures for the SCR observation model likelihood
    lam <- model$lam
    lam.cand <- matrix(0,nrow=M,ncol=J)
    G.true <- model$G.true
    ll.y.sight <- rep(0,J)
    ll.y.sight.cand <- rep(0,J)
   
    #Update first ID covariate, G.true[,1]. Metropolis-Hastings
    swap <- which(model$G.latent[1:M]==1) #can only update currently latent G's
    for(i in 1:length(swap)){
      G.cand <- rcat(1,model$gammaVec[1:nlevels])
      if(G.cand!=model$G.true[swap[i]]){
        #update ll.y
        d2 <- (model$s[swap[i],1]-model$X[1:J,1])^2 + (model$s[swap[i],2]-model$X[1:J,2])^2 #ideally wouldn't need to recalculate this
        lam.cand[swap[i],1:J]<- model$lam0[G.cand]*exp(-d2/(2*model$sigma[G.cand]^2))
        if(model$z[swap[i]]==1){
          ll.y.sight <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
          ll.y.sight.cand <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam.cand[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
        }else{
          ll.y.sight <-rep(0,J)
          ll.y.sight.cand <-rep(0,J)
        }
        #update ll.cat
        ll.cat <- dcat(G.true[swap[i]],prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        ll.cat.cand <- dcat(G.cand,prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        prop.for <- model$gammaVec[G.cand]
        prop.back <- model$gammaVec[G.true[swap[i]]]
       
        #sum log likelihoods and do MH step
        lp_initial <- ll.cat+sum(ll.y.sight)
        lp_proposed <- ll.cat.cand+sum(ll.y.sight.cand)
        log_MH_ratio <- (lp_proposed+log(prop.back)) - (lp_initial+log(prop.for))
        accept <- decide(log_MH_ratio)
       
        if(accept){
          G.true[swap[i]] <- G.cand
          lam[swap[i],] <- lam.cand[swap[i],]
        }
       
      }
    }
    #Put stuff back into model
    model$lam <<- lam
    model$G.true <<- G.true
   
    #update logProb
    model.lp.proposed <- model$calculate(calcNodes)
   
    copy(from = model, to = mvSaved, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
  },
  methods = list( reset = function () {} )
)

parts: Just in case this is helpful for others, I had another problem replacing a sampler with a custom sampler in parallel and Perry's suggestion here to replace the "type" with the object itself solved the problem.
On Wednesday, February 12, 2020 at 3:25:27 PM UTC-5, pdevalpine wrote:

We had another issue involving parallelization recently that might be related.

Can you try providing the Gsampler object itself as the `type` argument to addSampler?

In other words, somewhere you have

Gsampler <- nimbleFunction(...) 

Instead of "type = 'Gsampler'", can you try "type = Gsampler".  Thanks.

Also it looks like everything is sourced inside the foreach loop, which is good.

-Perry
On Wed, Feb 12, 2020 at 11:53 AM Ben Augustine <baug...@vt.edu> wrote:

I am trying to test a Spatial Mark-resight sampler with categorical identity covariates that requires 2 sets of custom updates. It works fine when running one model at a time, but fails when replacing one of the samplers in a parallel environment, even in the case of running a single instance in a parallel environment (1 core). It gives the error "Error in unserialize(socklist[[n]]: error reading from connection". The line in red below is the culprit. I've copied the offending "GSampler" code below. I know the file with the custom updates is loading because the error does not occur when replacing the "IDsampler" directly above where "GSampler" is replaced and both are in the same .R file which is loaded inside the foreach loop.

Ideas?

Ben

#------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom sampler to update G.true, subject to constraints stemming from G.use
#------------------------------------------------------------------
GSampler <- nimbleFunction(
  contains = sampler_BASE,
  setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
    # Defined stuff
    M <- control$M
    J <- control$J
    K2D <- control$K2D
    nlevels <- control$nlevels
    calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)
  },
  run = function() {
    #Structures for the SCR observation model likelihood
    lam <- model$lam
    lam.cand <- matrix(0,nrow=M,ncol=J)
    G.true <- model$G.true
    ll.y.sight <- rep(0,J)
    ll.y.sight.cand <- rep(0,J)
   
    #Update first ID covariate, G.true[,1]. Metropolis-Hastings
    swap <- which(model$G.latent[1:M]==1) #can only update currently latent G's
    for(i in 1:length(swap)){
      G.cand <- rcat(1,model$gammaVec[1:nlevels])
      if(G.cand!=model$G.true[swap[i]]){
        #update ll.y
        d2 <- (model$s[swap[i],1]-model$X[1:J,1])^2 + (model$s[swap[i],2]-model$X[1:J,2])^2 #ideally wouldn't need to recalculate this
        lam.cand[swap[i],1:J]<- model$lam0[G.cand]*exp(-d2/(2*model$sigma[G.cand]^2))
        if(model$z[swap[i]]==1){
          ll.y.sight <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
          ll.y.sight.cand <- dpois(model$y.sight.true[swap[i],],K2D[swap[i],]*lam.cand[swap[i],],log=TRUE)
        }else{
          ll.y.sight <-rep(0,J)
          ll.y.sight.cand <-rep(0,J)
        }
        #update ll.cat
        ll.cat <- dcat(G.true[swap[i]],prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        ll.cat.cand <- dcat(G.cand,prob=model$gammaVec[1:nlevels],log=TRUE)
        prop.for <- model$gammaVec[G.cand]
        prop.back <- model$gammaVec[G.true[swap[i]]]
       
        #sum log likelihoods and do MH step
        lp_initial <- ll.cat+sum(ll.y.sight)
        lp_proposed <- ll.cat.cand+sum(ll.y.sight.cand)
        log_MH_ratio <- (lp_proposed+log(prop.back)) - (lp_initial+log(prop.for))
        accept <- decide(log_MH_ratio)
       
        if(accept){
          G.true[swap[i]] <- G.cand
          lam[swap[i],] <- lam.cand[swap[i],]
        }
       
      }
    }
    #Put stuff back into model
    model$lam <<- lam
    model$G.true <<- G.true
   
    #update logProb
    model.lp.proposed <- model$calculate(calcNodes)
   
    copy(from = model, to = mvSaved, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
  },
  methods = list( reset = function () {} )
)



#####Nimble Model

NimModel <- nimbleCode({
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  # priors for detection and augmentation parameters
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  for(i in 1:nlevels){
      lam0[i]~dunif(0,10)       
      sigma[i]~dunif(0,10)
  }
  psi~dunif(0,1)
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  # dirichlet priors for category/genotype level frequencies
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  for(k in 1:nlevels){
    alpha[k] <- 1 # parameters
  }
  gammaVec[1:nlevels]~ddirch(alpha[1:nlevels])
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  # likelihoods
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  for(i in 1:M) {
    # latent activity centers
    # currently this assumes a rectangular state space
    # could apply some form of the Meredith trick for an irregular state space
    s[i,1] ~ dunif(xlim[1],xlim[2])
    s[i,2] ~ dunif(ylim[1],ylim[2])
    lam[i,1:J] <- GetDetectionRate(s = s[i,1:2], X = X[1:J,1:2], J=J,
                                   sigma=sigma[G.true[i]], lam0=lam0[G.true[i]], z=z[i],ID=ID[1:n.samp.latent],
                                   G.latent=G.latent[1:M])#ID and G.latent here as a NIMBLE hack
    # Capture model
    # but y.sight.true is latent, requires custom update - see custom IDsampler
    for(j in 1:J) {
      y.sight.true[i,j] ~ dpois(K2D[i,j]*lam[i,j])
    }
   
    # Model for categorical identity covariates/genotypes (individual by covariate)
    # G.true also requires custom update - see GSampler 
   
    G.true[i]~dcat(gammaVec[1:nlevels])
   
  }
 
  # Data augmentation part
  for(i in (n.marked+1):M){
    z[i] ~ dbern(psi)
  }
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  #calculate number of unmarked inds captured, and total pop size
  #--------------------------------------------------------------
  n.cap <- Getncap(y.sight.true=y.sight.true[1:M,1:J],z=z[1:M],M=M,J=J,n.marked=n.marked)
  N <- sum(z[1:M])
})# end model
